opsHint.restartLoggerWorker: Restarts the Logger: stops and starts historian writes. Medium risk: short gap in history; acquisition keeps running.
opsHint.restartCatalogReplicator: Restarts catalog replication (tags/machines vs historian). Medium risk: sync pauses for a few seconds; the local catalog stays up.
opsHint.restartMetricsSampler: Restarts the metrics sampler for this dashboard. Low risk: the snapshot goes stale until it returns; acquisition and detection are unaffected.
opsHint.forceSync: Forces catalog sync with the historian now. Low risk: extra load and a 30 s cooldown; no data is deleted.
opsHint.cleanOrphans: Drops pending orphan rows older than the chosen age. Medium risk: may delete tag-machine links the historian has not resolved yet.
opsHint.rebuildDerived: Ensures wavelet .f tags and deletes .f whose source is gone. Medium risk: a machine subscribed to an orphan .f loses that input.
opsHint.forceReplicate: Asks SAF to drain the pending queue to the historian now. Low risk: samples are not discarded.
opsHint.emptyQueue: Discards ALL PENDING samples in the SAF journal. Critical risk: irreversible loss of pending history.

files.wrongProblemType: is '{{problem}}', but {{slot}} expects {{want}}. Do not mix detection/diagnosis or PFM/Observer
files.labelColumnOtherRole: label_column='{{column}}' belongs to another role. Slot: {{slot}}
files.observerOutputKey: output_key must be 'leak_flow' in {{slot}} (a PFM LEAKFLOW file cannot be used here)
files.pfmLeakflowOutputKey: output_key='leak_flow' belongs to Observer Detection, not {{slot}}

banners.needsFluid: LDS stays in starting: add at least one fluid in Fluids and densities (name, min and max density) and click Save.
banners.noEngines: No detection engine is active. Enable at least PPA, NPW, PFM or Observer in Detection engines and click Save (adding or removing engines requires a restart).

fields.detection_thresholdHelp: Minimum combined confidence to consider a leak. For example, 60% requires fusion of all engines to reach at least that value.
fields.on_delayHelp: Consecutive seconds that fusion must stay above the threshold before declaring a leak. Filters short spikes.
fields.p_leakHelp: How often you expect leaks on this pipeline before looking at the engines. A low value (e.g. 0.01) assumes leaks are rare.
fields.negative_evidenceHelp: If enabled, a motor in normal operation reduces leak confidence. If off, only motors that detected count.
fields.orphan_auto_restart_sHelp: Time an individual motor stays leaking without LDS confirmation before auto-restart. Default: 2 min.
fields.fleet_auto_restart_enabledHelp: Default off. If enabled, when LDS and all detection motors are leaking and nobody restarts them, the whole fleet (including LDS) auto-restarts.
fields.fleet_auto_restart_sHelp: Time with LDS and all detection motors leaking, without operator restart, before auto-restarting the fleet. Only applies if the switch is Yes.
fields.module_PFMHelp: Pressure-flow monitoring engine. Requires a loaded LGBM model.
fields.module_ObserverHelp: Estimates leak flow. Requires a loaded LGBM model.
fields.fluidsHelp: Density ranges to identify the fluid in transit. Save applies the table immediately.
fields.flow_variance_thresholdHelp: If flow variance exceeds this value, LDS classifies the pipeline as transient (startups, setpoint changes).
fields.flow_shutin_thresholdHelp: If average flow drops below this value, LDS classifies the pipeline as shut-in.

fields.window_sizeHelp: Population window. Must be greater than N1.
fields.sample_window_sizeHelp: Recent sample. Must be smaller than N0 (window size).
fields.on_delayHelp: Seconds in pre-alarm before declaring a leak.

fields.pipeline_length_mHelp: Length between pressure sensors, in metres.
fields.speed_of_soundHelp: Effective acoustic speed in the fluid.

sections.inputs_mappingHint: Assign plant channels. Each list shows channel → model input (e.g. Outlet flow → MASS_FLOW_T1).

subscribeHints.inlet_flow: PFM models work in mass flow. If the field tag is volumetric, also subscribe inlet density; without it the engine stays in Waiting. If it is mass flow, density is optional and lets you estimate leaked volume in diagnosis.
subscribeHints.outlet_flow: PFM models work in mass flow. If the field tag is volumetric, also subscribe outlet density; without it the engine stays in Waiting. If it is mass flow, density is optional and lets you estimate leaked volume in diagnosis.
subscribeHints.inlet_density: Inlet density converts volumetric flow to mass flow (required in that case) and lets you report leaked volume when flow is already mass.
subscribeHints.outlet_density: Outlet density converts volumetric flow to mass flow (required in that case) and lets you report leaked volume when flow is already mass.

sections.inputs_mappingHint: Assign plant channels. Each list shows channel → model input (e.g. Outlet flow → MASS_FLOW_T1).

fields.on_delayHelp: Confirmation: consecutive seconds above the pre-alarm threshold before declaring a leak.

subscribeHints.inlet_flow: Inlet flow (kg/s or m³/s). If the tag is volumetric, also subscribe inlet density; without it the engine stays in Waiting. If it is mass flow, density is optional and lets you estimate leaked volume in diagnosis.
subscribeHints.outlet_flow: Outlet flow (kg/s or m³/s). If the tag is volumetric, also subscribe outlet density; without it the engine stays in Waiting. If it is mass flow, density is optional and lets you estimate leaked volume in diagnosis.
subscribeHints.inlet_density: Inlet density (kg/m³) — required if flow is volumetric
subscribeHints.outlet_density: Outlet density (kg/m³) — required if flow is volumetric
